name: TEM-1 Activity Screen
description: Round 3 v1 TEM-1 nitrocefin activity screen. Builds the 8-compound R3 layout with no vehicle+TEM-1 control wells, then leaves the plate ready for manual A490 readout.

nodes.label: Prepare Dilutions
nodes.description: Prepare TEM-1 working solution, compound/control working solutions, and matched vehicle before assay setup. Nitrocefin remains a separate just-in-time source.

nodes.label: Pick Up Pipette
nodes.description: Pick up the starting pipette. Transfer helpers swap to the correct pipette by volume.

nodes.label: Dispense TEM-1 Prep
nodes.description: Add 20 uL prepared TEM-1 working solution to positive-control and test-compound wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense No-Enzyme Prep
nodes.description: Add 20 uL BLB to negative-control wells in one batch.

nodes.label: Dispense Vehicle
nodes.description: Add 5 uL prepared matched vehicle to no-enzyme controls in one batch.

nodes.label: Dispense Positive Control
nodes.description: Add 5 uL prepared positive-control working solution to positive-control wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 1
nodes.description: Add prepared test compound 1 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 2
nodes.description: Add prepared test compound 2 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 3
nodes.description: Add prepared test compound 3 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 4
nodes.description: Add prepared test compound 4 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 5
nodes.description: Add prepared test compound 5 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 6
nodes.description: Add prepared test compound 6 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 7
nodes.description: Add prepared test compound 7 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 8
nodes.description: Add prepared test compound 8 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Place Pipette for Plate Mix
nodes.description: Return the pipette before the right arm moves the assay plate to the shaker.

nodes.label: Grab Plate for Mixing
nodes.description: Pick up the assay plate for whole-plate shaker mixing.

nodes.label: Open Shaker for Mixing
nodes.description: Open the wellplate shaker lid.

nodes.label: Load Plate into Shaker
nodes.description: Load the assay plate into the shaker for whole-plate mixing.

nodes.label: Close Shaker for Mixing
nodes.description: Close the wellplate shaker lid before mixing.

nodes.label: Start Plate Mix
nodes.description: Start the wellplate shaker for whole-plate mixing.

nodes.label: Wait for Plate Mix
nodes.description: Run the shaker for the configured plate-mixing duration.

nodes.label: Stop Plate Mix
nodes.description: Stop the wellplate shaker after mixing.

nodes.label: Open Shaker After Mix
nodes.description: Open the shaker so the plate can be unloaded.

nodes.label: Unload Mixed Plate
nodes.description: Unload the mixed assay plate from the shaker.

nodes.label: Close Shaker After Mix
nodes.description: Close the shaker lid after unloading the plate.

nodes.label: Return Mixed Plate
nodes.description: Return the mixed assay plate to its home fixture before nitrocefin addition.

nodes.label: Pick Pipette After Mix
nodes.description: Pick the pipette back up for pre-incubation and nitrocefin addition.

nodes.label: Pre-Incubate
nodes.description: Wait after compound/control additions so compounds can interact with TEM-1 before nitrocefin starts the reaction.

nodes.label: Prepare Nitrocefin
nodes.description: Prepare 100 uM nitrocefin working solution immediately before assay initiation.

nodes.label: Nitrocefin: Positive Control
nodes.description: Add nitrocefin to positive-control replicates as one within-condition batch.

nodes.label: Nitrocefin: No-Enzyme Control
nodes.description: Add nitrocefin to no-enzyme negative-control replicates as one within-condition batch.

nodes.label: Nitrocefin: Compound 1
nodes.description: Add nitrocefin to compound 1 replicates as one within-condition batch.

nodes.label: Nitrocefin: Compound 2
nodes.description: Add nitrocefin to compound 2 replicates as one within-condition batch.

nodes.label: Nitrocefin: Compound 3
nodes.description: Add nitrocefin to compound 3 replicates as one within-condition batch.

nodes.description: Add nitrocefin to compound 4 replicates as one within-condition batch.

nodes.label: Place Pipette Back
nodes.description: Return whichever pipette is currently in hand to its stand.

nodes.description: Bundle the run log and timing artifacts into a named data folder before manual readout.
